notes.title: Remnant Records is out of Early Access!
notes.notes:
Today's the day!
Remnant Records 1.0 is [b]OUT NOW![/b]

The game is now feature-complete, with 4 roles, 6 maps, 6 ghosts, 14 special conditions, 17 perks, 19 skins, and an infinity of procedurally generated stories, made from 123 handcrafted story beats.

If you play before Feb 2nd, you'll earn the [b]new Medium "Raver" skin for free[/b]!

- NEW GHOST: the ANOMALY. The anomaly can be unlocked at level 6 from the progression screen (in the lobby, click on your level to access it).

- The title screen has been redone.

- Fixed a bug that caused the "start investigation" message to appear only for the host

Enjoy, exorcists!

notes.title: Update 4.0.0 - New Perk System, Summer Sale, and What's Coming Next!
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

[h2]PERKS SYSTEM[/h2]

Initially, we had planned to add subroles to each role, but we finally decided to take another path: we wanted to add more customization and replayability. Therefore, instead of subroles, you're getting a brand new [b]perk system[/b]!
Level up your roles by completing missions, buy new perks and customize your abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245591/745a972c73c79a681a9c234c6700197c34e08983.png[/img]

Play around with a variety of fun abilities: revive your allies as the bodyguard, follow the tracks of the ghosts as the electrician, or communicate with the dead as the medium.

[h2]CARTOMANCER DECK[/h2]

The cartomancer now has access to a variety of cards they can use to build their own customized deck. 

[h1]WHAT'S COMING NEXT[/h1]

[h2]NEW STORIES[/h2] The next step after the perks update is a new batch of stories. As usual, expect a whole lot more variety in the generated stories and new objects to interact with.

[h2]MORE PERKS AND CARDS[/h2] We'll be adding more perks and cards over the next few weeks, and even more later. Don't hesitate to send your ideas our way if you have any, via Discord or the Steam forums!

[h2]SKINS[/h2] Skins are the next big milestone after the role update. Keep your eyes peeled for some sneak peeks!

[h2]AND AFTER THAT?[/h2] More ghosts and maps are coming later. You won't be disappointed with what's coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245591/f67ae7fdc8b34e5bc3c2b62491089e8a7d997443.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[b]New Features & Changes[/b]
- [b]ROLE PERKS[/b]: level up your roles and buy perks. Find out more about this huge new feature in the room screen -> role menu. Plenty more perks will be added later. If you have ideas, send them our way!
- [b]CARTOMANCER DECK[/b]: the cartomancer can now build their own customized deck of cards. More cards are coming soon!

[b]Adjustments[/b]
- Renamed the musclehead to bodyguard
- Changed the appearance of the players' ectoplasms
- Adjusted the color of the players' ectoplasms
- In the room menu, all windows now close when pressing Escape
- Backups are now created when switching to a different game version or when an error happens. You can access your saves folder through the ingame settings. If something happens to your save after switching between versions (for example: you are reset to level 1), just go to your saves folder, look for the latest save with your game version number, duplicate it then rename it to "save.dat". It will become your active save file.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused ALT-tabbing to interfere with push-to-talk when ALT was used as the push-to-talk key
- Fixed a bug that caused some lights to be visible through the medium's vision

[b]Note:[/b] new content is only in English for now. Other translations are coming in the next few days. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: An update on the roadmap: what's coming before the end of the year
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In August, we shared a roadmap of what was planned for 2022 and later. Here's what we've released so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245591/a92f60289c7ed6d04c01a5d05c886806e13bb88e.png[/img]

Now, let's take a look at what's planned for this month.

[h2]New map: C------ C-----[/h2]

The new map is currently under construction, and coming along great. It's a lot more ambitious than what we had originally planned, and we do not mean bigger... you'll get to find out how soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245591/482022005669709869d1883a53e77536ce0aa400.png[/img]

[h2]New texts and objects[/h2]

While ghosts and maps are exciting new content, we know that the stories are the heart of the game. In the upcoming update, dozens of new texts, objects and situations will appear. We've also overhauled the way stories are generated, guaranteeing a much larger variety of combinations. This will also ensure that some texts don't appear too often (looking at you, "cheating partner"!).

[h2]Reworks: the mannequin's exorcism and the orphan[/h2]

For now, we've focused the development on the new map and content, and we've realized we probably won't have enough time to finish everything. While we feel confident about the mannequin's exorcism, the orphan's rework may be pushed back to early 2023. No worries however, it'll be worth the wait!

[h2]Player skins[/h2]

We've decided to bundle the player skins together with the upcoming "role specialties" in a big "characters" update, planned for early 2023. That'll give us more time to polish it and provide you with a variety of skins. We hope you'll enjoy what we have planned!
As a reminder, the game won't have any micro-transactions: all skins have to be bought with an in-game currency earned through missions. More info on that later!


Thank you again for your support and patience. We can't wait for you to discover the next update!
Join the Discord for more updates and to chat with us:

notes.title: Devlog #2: Towards more engaging storylines
notes.notes:
Remnant Records has now been out for more than a month, and what a ride it has been! We can never thank you enough for your engagement and support.

Still, this is only the beginning of this project. There is a lot more we want to show you, and you’ve already had a glimpse through the roadmap. Here’s a little reminder:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42245591/1d2b0ecc03b4c82c9b3cf47a136a958a12fb2a8f.png[/img]

Do note this isn’t an exhaustive list. Expect surprises in the coming months!

One of those surprises is the very subject of this devlog.

[h2]RANDOMLY GENERATED MYSTERIES[/h2]
If you’ve already played the game before, you know how a mission works: you enter a haunted place, look for clues to understand what happened to the people that used to live here, and use the information you’ve gathered to perform the exorcism.

Piecing together the story is the core gameplay of the investigation phase of a mission. For players to keep enjoying it, it needs to stay fresh, to surprise them occasionally, and to be believable.

The system works right now, but some aspects have left me unsatisfied. Here is what’s planned to make it more solid and engaging.

[h2]THE STORY OF A PERSON RATHER THAN A LIST OF EVENTS[/h2]
With missions being procedurally generated, some will inevitably feel better than others. Our goal is to finetune the system to encourage coherent and natural storytelling. Right now, some missions can feel like fetch quests, with every text mentioning an item and being quite disconnected from each other. We want each mission to feel like a complete story that gets unraveled, with the protagonist being our ghost.

One of our solutions for this is the upcoming personality system. Each ghost will get multiple personality traits assigned to them, and the texts they leave behind will depend on those. This will help each ghost feel like a real person with their own personal story, their own way to express themselves, and their very own character.

In the future, these personality traits may even get reflected in the ghost’s behavior during the investigation and exorcism phase. Stay tuned!

[h2]NOT ALL DOOM AND GLOOM[/h2]
As we all know, people who’ve had peaceful lives don’t become ghosts. However, that doesn’t mean that ghosts should have had only terrible or tragic moments in their lives. We want to put more emphasis on positive events that happened in the ghosts’ lives, and make them feel even more like real people, with qualities and flaws, good times and bad times.

To help with that, we also plan to put more focus on environmental clues. There are already quite a few in the game: all the information you’re looking for isn’t always in the texts. For example, try putting flowers on the exorcism table when you notice that the ghost’s room is full of plants!

[h2]MORE OF THE SAME[/h2]
All those changes are very important, but we’re very aware of what the investigation phase needs the most: more content. All upcoming content updates will include dozens of new texts and new items, to help keep the experience fresh.

[h2]AND THE BEST PART: YOU CAN HELP[/h2]
If, when playing the game, you sometimes feel you’ve been suddenly struck by inspiration… here’s a way for you to leave your mark in the game, and help create more content! We've setup a form in which you can submit texts to be used in the game. Do note: there is no guarantee the texts you send will be used, and they may be lightly or heavily edited.

Your texts don’t have to be perfect, or even complete. Don’t hesitate to even submit simply “ideas” for texts. We’re always grateful for your contribution and support!

Here’s the form: [url=https://forms.gle/dG53ywzbwNqJYVeV8]https://forms.gle/dG53ywzbwNqJYVeV8[/url]

---

Everything that’s been mentioned in this devlog is planned for the coming months. That doesn’t mean that’s it: the story system will keep improving over the entire duration of Early Access, and we want to do even more ambitious things with it, though I can’t go into details on this right now. Keep the suggestions flowing, we’re listening!

I hope you enjoyed reading this devlog. More will come, on a very irregular schedule. Don’t forget you can come and chat with us and the community on [url=https://discord.gg/Uf8EpWsFts]our Discord[/url].

Yours truly,
EraKles

notes.title: Devlog #1: Reworking the exorcism phase
notes.notes:
[quote][b]💡 Reminder:[/b] Remnant Records is a coop horror investigation game. You enter haunted places, try to understand what happened to the people that lived there by gathering the clues left behind, and finally exorcise them.[/quote]
The beta has now been out for more than two weeks. How have you been enjoying it? If you still don’t have your beta key, it’s not too late. Join our Discord and head to the channel #request-access to get yours: [url=https://t.co/ACMSFoCq4G]discord.gg/Uf8EpWsFts[/url]

This is the first devlog for Remnant Records. It gives some insight on the behind the scenes of the development process.

[h2]THE EXORCISM PHASE[/h2]
One of the most common criticisms we’ve received on the main gameplay loop was the exorcism phase. It’s pretty cool for the first few times; players anxiously light up the candle, sigh with relief when they see it turn blue, then hold their breath again trying to survive the inevitable pursuit. However, this system has some glaring problems.

First problem, it gets old fast. Once you’ve learned that the optimal strategy is most of the times simply hiding in a closet, you just do that and wait for time to tick. You either get caught or you don’t, but it feels more like a luck-based situation than a tense gameplay segment.

Second problem, this mechanic is apparently very confusing for some players. I’ve watched a lot of friends and acquaintances play the game, as it gives me very interesting insight on how new players perceive the game. When their first exorcism succeeds, most players freeze. I would have thought their survival instinct would kick in and they would either try to run away or hide somewhere, but no: the vast majority of players freeze right around the exorcism table and wait for their demise. When I first witnessed this, I was a bit baffled. But when it’s happened to such a large number of people, it obviously means it’s a bad design and not simply user error.

So, what’s the solution? We’ve been thinking about this for a good while, and here’s what we got:

[h2]EXORCISM BOSS FIGHTS[/h2]
Well, not really. You still won’t be able to fight back against spirits, and you [i]still[/i] won’t get a gun. But it appeared that giving the players an objective during the exorcism was crucial. We decided to give each spirit type a unique objective to fulfill during a successful exorcism.

But how to communicate what to do to the players? The game has an extremely minimal UI, and we definitely didn’t want to add text instructions on screen as if it was a WarioWare minigame. Another solution was adding it to the tutorial, but…

[olist][*]That means adding four whole parts (for the four spirits), and even more in the future! That’d make for a super long and bloated tutorial.[/*][*]People already do not read the tutorial in its entirety. From what I’ve seen, it seems most people mentally skip every other line of text. Sometimes, they even invent things they believe they’ve read in the tutorial! It’s kind of impressive, but I, too, have a very short attention span, so I get it. [/*][/olist]
In conclusion, it’s best to keep tutorials short and to the point.

So, in the end, we decided to let players trust their instinct, and not give any text instruction. Will that work out? Well, we’ll see. Maybe it’s a big mistake, and we’ll have to change everything again. But it’s an interesting experiment!

[quote][b]🤫 Warning:[/b] Light spoilers on the new exorcism phase of the shusher below. If you want to discover everything by yourself when it comes out in beta (very soon!), stop reading now.[/quote]
[h2]THE SHUSHER’S REWORKED EXORCISM PHASE[/h2]
The shusher is the very first spirit we designed. She’s gone through the most reworks, so it’s only natural she gets to have the first [i]brand new exorcism phase[/i].

We started brainstorming, and had lots of ideas, but all of them felt a bit unnatural; as if we were suddenly adding a Zelda-like puzzle in the middle of an otherwise immersion-oriented horror game. We knew that even though lore isn’t central to this game, this exorcism phase had to be well integrated in the ingame world so as not to break immersion.

We ended up giving the shusher a lantern that only lights up during the exorcism, letting her patrol around looking for prey. When the lantern lights up, as the shusher is weakened by the exorcism, the souls of her victims escape and scatter in the house. Maybe they’d be willing to help you? That’s for you to find out.

The shusher has a lot of unique features, but her most memorable one is right in the name: she can mute players to stop them from talking with each other. It does not, however, stop them from communicating: I’ve seen players “talk” when muted by flashing their torches quickly, jumping around, shaking their head…

Because of this, we decided the shusher’s exorcism phase also had to have a focus on communication.

So, let’s sum this up… we’ve got a patrolling spirit, potentially helpful escaped souls, and a mission to fulfill that’ll put your communication to the test. Sounds like a good time!

[hr][/hr]
The new shusher exorcism phase will be available very soon on the beta (v1.4.0). Your feedback will be very helpful to know whether all of this is too cryptic - or just cryptic enough - and what we should adjust. Other spirits will also get their own exorcism makeover later on.

I hope you enjoyed reading this devlog. More will come in the future, so let me know if there’s a specific subject you’d like me to tackle. You can come and discuss this devlog, the game, and anything else you want on our Discord: [url=https://t.co/ACMSFoCq4G]discord.gg/Uf8EpWsFts[/url]



Yours truly,
EraKles
